sources.supports: Vitamin C deficiency is treatable; mild cases can respond to dietary fruit/vegetables and improvement commonly occurs within days.
sources.limits: Not a measured 1848 dose or a guarantee that any small basket treats severe scurvy. Exact game feeding threshold and damage remain authored.

sources.supports: Vitamin C deficiency can produce major gait and musculoskeletal symptoms and responds to treatment; prompt recognition matters.
sources.limits: Selected modern pediatric clinical sample, not an emigrant survival-rate or pack-strength study. Therapeutic supplementation is not directly equivalent to the game's fruit basket.

sources.supports: Functions can improve within days of treatment while some signs take weeks to resolve.
sources.limits: Game does not prescribe doses or model clinical physiology; the retained fourteen nutritional recovery-day requirement is a game rule.
